_: Pinned occurrences of internal vocabulary in this PUBLIC repo. Codes are defined by scripts/guard-public-vocabulary.py --legend; they are codes rather than words so that this file needs no self-exclusion from the scan. Every entry carries a measured count and a reason; an entry without a real reason is a defect.

V1.why: public API of this SwiftPM package. V1 names a public enum, three public static functions and two error cases that customers compile against, plus the doc comments that explain them. Renaming them is a SOURCE-BREAKING change to a published package, so it is an owner decision, not a text edit.

V11.why: public refusal and verdict CONTRACT, not prose. These are the wire strings a caller switches on: two V1_* error codes, one V2_ATTACH_REFUSED code, and the six hyphenated verdicts the evaluator returns (each spells a V-code by construction). Changing any of them changes behaviour for every integrator: owner-level.
